recognize_zh: 低倍網狀纖維染色下，骨小樑旁的整個造血區域都布滿細密交錯的黑色網狀纖維，把每群細胞框成網格狀，纖維明顯瀰漫增加，符合骨髓纖維化。
features: Diffuse, dense increase in reticulin fibers throughout the intertrabecular space
Fibers form an extensive intersecting meshwork outlining small cell groups
Streaming fiber orientation parallel to the trabecula at the upper center
Residual scattered fat spaces and a dilated sinus
Bony trabecula at right and upper left; megakaryocyte clusters not resolvable at this power
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy stained for reticulin shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers with extensive intersections forming a meshwork throughout the intertrabecular marrow, with streaming along the trabecular surface. Scattered fat spaces and a dilated sinus remain. The pattern corresponds to at least MF-2 reticulin fibrosis; megakaryocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification or stain and requires the corresponding H&E. Findings are consistent with myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Normal or MF-1 marrow shows a loose network of fine fibers with few intersections, mainly perivascular, rather than a dense diffuse meshwork.
HCL also shows diffuse fine reticulin, but the H&E shows spaced fried-egg lymphoid cells that are CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive.
Metastatic carcinoma causes focal dense fibrosis around keratin-positive tumor nests rather than an even diffuse mesh.
